title: Secure Boot vs. Measured Boot
description: A two-column Mermaid flowchart contrasting Secure Boot (enforcement — verify each stage's signature and halt on failure) with Measured Boot (recording — hash each stage and extend a TPM PCR, then run unconditionally), with hover details on each stage.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

learningObjectives: Compare Secure Boot (enforcement) with Measured Boot (recording).
Explain why a PCR is extend-only and what that guarantees.
Describe why production systems use both mechanisms together.

instructionalStrategies: Walk the left column and ask what happens at each FAIL diamond, then walk the right column and contrast it.
Have students articulate the difference between preventing a bad boot and proving what booted.

assessmentQuestions.question: Why does Measured Boot let an unsigned kernel run, and how is that still useful?
An attacker swaps the bootloader. How does each mechanism respond?
